title: UniversalH0ProjectiveNormalization
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, choose D(R), and let P be a bounded cochain complex of finite projective R-modules [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. Suppose for every commutative R-algebra B that the termwise scalar extension B tensor P has zero homology in every negative degree and H0 is isomorphic as a B-module to B. Then there exists a bounded complex Q, each term explicitly a retract of a finite free R-module, with Q^n=0 for n<0 and d:Q^0→Q^1 zero, and Q(P) is isomorphic to Q(Q) in D(R). No scheme morphism or coefficient sheaf occurs.

proof.text: Apply universalConnective_projective_model to the negative-homology half of the universal hypothesis, producing a connective bounded finite projective complex C and a homotopy equivalence P -> C.

Extension of scalars is additive because it is left adjoint to additive restriction. Map the homotopy equivalence through scalar extension and its homology isomorphism. Compose its inverse with the rank-one H0 isomorphism for P, obtaining the universal H0 hypothesis for C.
Apply connective_universalH0_zero_differential to C, obtaining Q with zero negative terms and d0=0 and a homotopy equivalence C -> Q.

For each finite projective term of Q apply Module.Finite.exists_comp_eq_id_of_projective. Transfer its Fin m function-module retraction through the linear equivalence with ULift(Fin m) finitely supported functions, and verify the composite on every element. Compose the two homotopy equivalences; its hom map is a quasi-isomorphism, so the derived localization yields the required isomorphism.

theorem universalH0_projective_normalization
    (R : Type v) [CommRing R] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{v} R)]
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R) ℤ)
    (hb : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (P.X n))
    (hf : ∀ n : ℤ, Module.Finite R (P.X n))
    (hp : ∀ n : ℤ, Module.Projective R (P.X n))
    (hbase : ∀ (B : Type v) [CommRing B] (φ : R →+* B),
      let PB := ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
      (∀ i : ℤ, i < 0 → IsZero (PB.homology i)) ∧
        Nonempty (PB.homology 0 ≅ ModuleCat.of B B)) :
    ∃ Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R) ℤ,
      (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (Q.X n)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ m : ℕ,
        ∃ (ι : Q.X n ⟶ ModuleCat.of R (ULift.{v} (Fin m) →₀ R))
          (π : ModuleCat.of R (ULift.{v} (Fin m) →₀ R) ⟶ Q.X n),
          ι ≫ π = 𝟙 (Q.X n)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, n < 0 → IsZero (Q.X n)) ∧ Q.d 0 1 = 0 ∧
      Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)
